# Testing

```sh
python -m pytest -q        # the full suite, including golden outputs and the reference texts
ruff check .               # unused and undefined names (pyflakes rules only; layout is left to the author)
```

Jeez, tests have one primary owner in `tests/{user,functional,architecture,contributor}/`, matching the
documentation layers. [The test indexes](../../tests/README.md) list every module'n its responsibility;
the [functional specification](../functional/README.md#tests-as-behavioural-specification) links behaviour to
its checks. Shared corpus, fixtures, `conftest.py` and reference helpers remain at tests root.

Run one layer with `python -m pytest -q tests/functional` (or another layer folder\). Well, the full command above
collects them all. When moving tests, compare every collected test identity'n parameter case, update
source/fixture/documentation paths'n the exact promotion skip allowlist, and run the full suite.

`tests/contributor/test_docs.py` parses authoritative plain sources and ungenerated current docs/skill command examples, including inline commands,
shell fences, pipes and redirections, without executing shell scripts or paid API calls. It also runs each
displayed `$ aussiefy` example through the CLI and checks its exact output (including explain stderr).
Historical ADRs/design reviews and the imported standard are excluded from the current-command contract.
Published copies are not scanned again. A source edit may precede regeneration during development; promotion
requires `python scripts/publish_docs.py check`, which enforces fresh output and links in both trees.

`tests/functional/test_retelling.py` exercises a session with provider SDK imports blocked, neutral tool
contracts and the real MCP stdio entry point from another working directory. Candidate paths are explicit,
so isolated release worktrees exercise their own code. This verifies the shared agent boundary, not live
Claude or Codex model execution. Client setup commands are documented in [agent integration](../user/agents.md).

## The golden corpus

`tests/corpus/sentences.txt` holds the plain-English sentence corpus. `tests/corpus/golden.yaml` pins the output
for every sentence at every level at seeds 0 and 1, and for every reference text at every level at seed 0.
`tests/architecture/test_golden.py` compares against it.

After an intended change to the engine or the dictionary, regenerate it'n review the diff like any other
code change:

```sh
python scripts/regen_golden.py && git diff tests/corpus/golden.yaml
```

Never edit `golden.yaml` by hand, and don't accept a regenerated diff without readin' it: an unexpected
change is a regression until shown otherwise.

## Reference texts

`tests/corpus/reference/` holds public-domain texts, from fairy tales to the Declaration of Independence and The
Raven, plus Luke 10:25–37 (the Good Samaritan) from the public-domain World English Bible Classic;
`tests/corpus/reference/SOURCES.yaml` lists each one and where it came from. `tests/functional/test_reference.py`
checks them at every level across 20 seeds. Four of them, for example:

| Text | What it tests |
|---|---|
| Gettysburg Address | Sense accuracy: every swap must be one of the speech's real meanings (war, dying, enduring, soldiers, the people, liberty and so on), with no "ripper civil war". Level 5 must reach most of them, while levels 1–2 stay light |
| Goldilocks (a plain retelling written for this corpus) | Hit rate: swaps must rise with level and the senses must be right (a girl is never a "sheila") |
| The Hare and the Tortoise (Aesop, Townsend 1867) | Archaic syntax: "fell fast asleep" is not about speed |
| Waltzing Matilda (popular 1903 lyrics) | Existing slang: swagman, billabong and jumbuck survive, with nothing to translate and line breaks intact |

Fair dinkum, every run is also checked for well\-formed output: no broken punctuation, correct a/an, openers followed by
lower case, and the same garnish placement never in adjacent sentences.

## Target translations and the benchmark

`tests/corpus/targets/` holds target translations, such as a refined LLM renderin' of Gettysburg at level 5.
`aussiefy compare` measures how much of a target's slang the engine reproduces across seeds, two ways:

- **Aligned spans,** for close translations: `test_benchmark_against_target_translation` holds the engine to
  60% of the Gettysburg target's spans over 10 seeds.
- **Vocabulary overlap,** for targets that restructure or extend the text, like the agent's Goldilocks:
  `test_goldilocks_benchmark_vocabulary_overlap` holds it to 60% of the dictionary phrases in that target.

Anyway, both bars should rise as the dictionary improves. Running `aussiefy dev harvest` on a target is how its misses become candidate
entries \(see [data acquisition](data-acquisition.md)).

## Classic Australian texts

`tests/corpus/classics/` holds public\-domain Australian poems'n stories \(Paterson, Lawson, Dennis and others\),
used as source material for the classics research round'n as test input. Its rules and manifest are in
[tests/corpus/classics/README.md](../../tests/corpus/classics/README.md).

## Everyday texts

[tests/corpus/everyday/](../../tests/corpus/everyday/README.md) adds committed inputs spanning instructions, news,
conversation'n workplace/technical registers. Each group has an attributed source/licence manifest. A
bounded three\-case level/seed check covers each committed input for repeatability'n source/record
integrity; plain `.txt` inputs also retain line counts. Strict Markdown tests cover syntax, hard wraps,
whole\-document context, unit offsets'n public warnings; extended markup tests include the MDX corpus. This doesn't extend the original 20\-seed, five\-level reference sweep.

Struth, the 15 pinned Interfold MDX pages now have confirmed LGPL redistribution evidence'n committed attribution.
Remote\-only Rockwell/Kieran material'n full research exports stay local. Anyway, only the
existin' two local\-corpus tests can skip; new corpus checks run without private files or network access.

## Remote-only texts, kept local

Works without confirmed redistribution permission stay local
([DD-011](../architecture/decisions/dd-011-copyrighted-texts-stay-local.md)); licensed imports and the
reviewed bounded exception are documented in [licensing](licensing.md). `tests/corpus/remote.yaml` points
at public copies, including the Moloch section of Ginsberg's *Howl* quoted in Scott Alexander's essay
*Meditations on Moloch*. `aussiefy dev ingest tests/corpus/remote.yaml` (with the `scrape` extra) saves excerpts to
the gitignored `tests/corpus/local/`, where `tests/functional/test_local_reference.py` tests them. With the folder empty,
those tests skip. How to fetch them, add your own, and keep Aussie versions alongside is in
[tests/corpus/local/README.md](../../tests/corpus/local/README.md).

## LLM modes

The LLM modes use scripted clients for acceptance and fallback tests. `test_claude.py` additionally runs the
real optional SDK through a mocked HTTP transport, checking serialized JSON requests, strict tool schemas,
prompt-cache markers, beta headers and parsed replies. The `dev` extra includes that SDK so these tests
cannot silently skip. No test contacts a model service. Live API execution remains an open item: see [limitations](../functional/limitations.md).


Release CI smoke\-tests Python 3.10 with the minimum API SDK \(0.120.0\), and Python 3.12 with the currently
resolved SDK. Both exercise CLI, dictionary, contracts, judge'n real stdio MCP/HTTP\-mock boundaries. The
required release\-head job depends on both smoke checks before its complete exact\-head/squash\-tree gate.


The [held-out refinement inputs](../../research/heldout-2026-10-16/README.md) add five fictional own\-work
texts plus that Bible passage for a six\-case repeat\-judge comparison. They're disjoint from the earlier
20\-source refinement by source hash; this isn't a claim about language\-model trainin' data. Anyway, source and
research derivatives retain their attributed provenance. The Bible fixture also participates in the full
reference level/seed property sweep'n has five golden level outputs; existin' golden cases are unchanged.
